decisionsTitle: The members' current tab is in view at 320 pixels
decisionsSection:
Amends §715 (the three tabs) and §360 (`SubNav`).

**The defect.** §715 drew the zone's three tabs, with their glyphs, in `SubNav`'s row that scrolls sideways rather than wraps. At 320 px the three entries needed about 350 px in a 288-px row, so on «Alergări» the current tab sat mostly past the edge and a member on a phone did not see where they were. §79 had learned the same of the backoffice's bar: the current tab must be in view.

**Decision, first: words that fit.** `SubNavItem` gains an optional `short`: below `sm` the entry draws it, from `sm` up it draws the full label; both are in the one link and the other is `display: none`, so the accessible name is never both. The zone gives each tab a short word from the catalogue (`Members.tabsShort`): «Coduri», «Magazin», «Alergări» and «Codes», «Shop», «Runs»; the full words («Coduri de reducere», «Discount codes») stay from `sm` up. The three entries with their glyphs then need about 265 px of the 288, the 44-px height and the glyphs kept, so the members' row does not scroll at all.

**Decision, second: rows that cannot fit bring the current entry into view.** Short words cannot help a long row. Measured at 320 px on the dev build (the row's scroll width in its 288 px): «Setări» 409 px (six entries; «Configurație», the widest, is last), «Pagini» 783 px (two captions, five entries with glyphs); the gallery's two halves, `/admin/tasks`'s row and the shop's three one-word tabs measure 288 in 288, they fit. For the two that overflow, the current entry loaded past the edge exactly as the members' did (on «Anti-robot» of «Setări» the row had to be at scrollLeft 121 to show it, on «Membri» of «Pagini» at 332). `SubNav` therefore renders `SubNavCurrent`, a client island that draws only a hidden `<span>`: once hydrated it sets the row's own `scrollLeft` so the `aria-current` entry is centred, never `scrollIntoView` (which also scrolls the page; `AdminTabs` does the same), and only when the row overflows and the entry is not already inside it, so a swipe is never undone. **It measures against the row, not the page:** the in-view test and the centring use client rects (`currentInView`, `centredScrollLeft` in `subnav-scroll.ts`, pure and unit-tested with a page gutter in the numbers), as `AdminTabs` does, because `offsetLeft` is measured from the entry's `offsetParent` and the row is not positioned, so it would include the gutter (16 px at 320, 24 px from `sm`). Chosen over `position: relative` on the row because it cannot depend on an ancestor's position. **It re-centres when the row's size changes** (a `ResizeObserver` on the row, disconnected on unmount: a late font swap, a rotation), still returning early when the entry is inside, so a member's swipe is not undone. It is a few lines and the only script `SubNav` carries; the row still works with JavaScript off, only without the jump. The participants' email previews' language switch is the same component and fits.

**Refused.** CSS `scroll-snap` on the current entry, with no script: a page that loads positioned at the start is not reliably re-snapped to the entry marked, and a measured row (783 px) could not be trusted to land on it. Short words for «Setări» alone: six entries still need about 420 px of 288, so they would not fit.

**Tests.** A unit test pins the short word beside the full one in a single link, the plain word when none is given, the catalogue in both languages and the island inside the nav; the e2e `members-zone.spec.ts` checks, on the phone and on desktop, that the row has three links, that on the phone the codes link's name is exactly «Coduri», and that the current tab's box is inside the row's on each of the three tab pages, and that the current entry of «Setări» (two tabs), «Pagini» and «Galerie» is inside its row.

**Left as is.** `short` is passed for every members' tab although «Magazin»/«Alergări» (and «Shop»/«Runs») equal their full words: each such link draws the same word in two spans, one `display: none`, harmless, and uniform; the catalogue's four duplicate strings are kept (no checker objects).
changelogLine: - **The current tab is always in view on a phone** — the members' three tabs say «Coduri», «Magazin» and «Alergări» below the tablet width so they fit 320 px, and a longer row («Setări», «Pagini») scrolls its current entry into view. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: At 320 px the members' zone's tab row fits its three entries, each 44 px tall with its glyph, drawing a short word (`SubNavItem.short`, «Coduri», «Magazin», «Alergări») below `sm` and the full word from `sm` up, in one link whose accessible name is only one of them; on each tab page the current tab's box is inside the row's box (2026-10-12, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

A sub-navigation row wider than the screen (`SubNav`: «Setări», «Pagini») scrolls its current entry into view once the page has hydrated and again when the row's size changes, by the row's own `scrollLeft`, measured against the row's rect (never `offsetLeft`), and only when that entry is not already inside it, so a swipe is never undone (2026-10-12, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).
